sentence: They hope to get a job and money so they can help their families.
synonym: They want to find work and earn money to support their families.
synonymNote: 两句都表达为了养家而寻找工作和收入的愿望，意思相同。

distractors.word: They plan to study hard so their families can rest.
distractors.note: 重点是学习，不是找工作赚钱，意思不同。

distractors.word: They decide to leave their families and travel alone.
distractors.note: 表达离开家人，与帮助家人的意思完全相反。

distractors.word: They need to spend money and enjoy life with friends.
distractors.note: 是花钱享乐，不是为家人找工作赚钱，意思不符。
